fields.name: small_icon
fields.description: Small icon used in various places like agent id, minimap, etc

fields.name: small_icon
fields.description: Small icon shown in various places like agent id, minimap, etc. Leave blank to fall back to icon found in agent_culture_details

fields.name: loyalty_is_applicable
fields.description: Enables and disables loyalty for a character if the faction features are setup to allow for it.

fields.name: can_be_loaned
fields.description: This character can be loaned under war coordination. Irrelevant if the character is a hero

fields.name: recruitable
fields.description: Can this agent subtype be recruited through normal means?

fields.name: audio_force_contextual_vo
fields.description: Force having contextual voice-over for the character. This is needed as in the code there is a hard-coded check for the agent subtype's key in order to disallow old characters (from wh) to have such voice-over.

localised_fields.name: onscreen_name_override
localised_fields.description: If this exists, this name will be used on ui for agents of this type. Otherwise will fallback to name in agent_culture_details

fields.name: move_points
fields.description: For generals (lords) and units they command, this is superseded by the campaign_action_points value in the land_units table. However, the AI uses this value when estimating the movement range of its forces

fields.name: encyclopedia_url
fields.description: URL for encyclopedia

fields.name: decal
fields.description: Example: RigidModels/Decals/battle/impact_decal.rigid_model_v2

fields.name: vfx_central
fields.description: Effect that appears in centre

fields.name: vfx_ring
fields.description: Effect that appears in ring around bounds

fields.name: spline_col_r
fields.description: Colour when in range or cast

fields.name: spline_col_g
fields.description: Colour when in range or cast

fields.name: spline_col_b
fields.description: Colour when in range or cast

fields.name: spline_oor_col_r
fields.description: Colour when out of casting range

fields.name: spline_oor_col_g
fields.description: Colour when out of casting range

fields.name: spline_oor_col_b
fields.description: Colour when out of casting range

fields.name: spline_animation_speed
fields.description: If not 0, spline will spin around. Higher the value, the slower it will spin. If set negative will spin opposite direction.

fields.name: spline_tile_count
fields.description: Default to 1 to have regular behaviour, this is how many times will repeat texture along spline

fields.name: composite_scene
fields.description: This is composite scene that will be rendered in centre (in same fashion as central vfx)

fields.name: is_targetting_per_entity
fields.description: This is for single click abilities where want aoe display to be shown per entity rather than per unit (mainly gyrobombers bomb drop ability)

fields.name: vfx_ring_segment_length
fields.description: If set to value other than -1, this is used to create number of segments instead of spline tile count

fields.name: use_model_time
fields.description: If true will animate in model time not real time

fields.name: spawn_no_proxy
fields.description: If you want to disable showing the spawned unit proxy/decal, please set this value to true

fields.name: army_special_ability
fields.description: Please don't add army abilities to this table unless they are explicitly designed to be usable in custom battle. This table is only used for junctioning army abilities to factions for custom battle, so it doesn't affect campaign.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: Group id, every Vortex Spell under the same group will spawn the same composite scenes

fields.name: trigger_delay
fields.description: If we need to delay this composite scene triggering

fields.name: freeze_position
fields.description: Composite scene will respect initial spell position

fields.name: freeze_rotation
fields.description: Composite scene will respect initial speel rotation

fields.name: change_max_angle
fields.description: Determines the maximum angle for the random change in direction of travel. Max is 360 degrees. 0 means that angle will never be changed.

fields.name: contact_effect
fields.description: If the vortex hits an entity, this ‘special_ability_phase’ will be applied on their unit.

fields.name: damage
fields.description: base damage dealt by the vortex at 100% damage scaling. Damage scales linearly towards the edge of the vortex radius.

fields.name: damage_ap
fields.description: armour-piercing damage dealt by the vortex at 100% damage scaling.

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Determines how long a vortex explosion will last in seconds.

fields.name: expansion_speed
fields.description: Determines the rate of expansion for the vortex. This value is per second. Expansion speed is also multiplied with ‘detonation_force’ to calculate momentum for impacts (knock back, knocked down, knocked flying). Note, vortices can have negative expansion speed, which will drag entities towards the centre of the vortex. If you use a negative expansion speed, start and goal radius need to be the same.

fields.name: goal_radius
fields.description: Determines the ultimate radius for the vortex. The vortex explosion will expand per second according to the ‘expansion_speed’ until goal radius is reached.

fields.name: infinite_height
fields.description: if set to yes the vortex will become a cylinder with infinite height rather than a globe.

fields.name: move_change_freq
fields.description: Determines how frequently the vortex movement will change direction of travel. This represents seconds.

fields.name: movement_speed
fields.description: Determines whether the centre of the vortex will move and a what speed. If movement_speed is 0, the vortex will stay static. This speed is meters per second.

fields.name: start_radius
fields.description: Determines the starting radius for the vortex. This is in meters.

fields.name: ignition_amount
fields.description: If set to a value higher than 0, it will deal fire damage.

fields.name: is_magical
fields.description: if yes it will deal magical damage.

fields.name: composite_scene
fields.description: links to a ‘composite_scene’, which is how we deliver the VFX and sounds for vortices.

fields.name: detonation_force
fields.description: Determines the force of impact for the vortex explosion. Multiplied with expansion speed to determine impact momentum.

fields.name: launch_source
fields.description: determines where the vortex will be launched from. Target_centre is used for explosions and vortices, target_near_centre for winds and breaths, activator front for vortices like night goblin fanatics.

fields.name: building_collision
fields.description: If the vortex centre collides with a building, will it “1.ignore”= bounce back into the opposite direction of travel or “2. Expire”=end.

fields.name: height_off_ground
fields.description: Determines the height for the centre of the vortex. Keep this at 0 unless you want to make a vortex that hits flyers mostly.

fields.name: delay
fields.description: We do spawn this at the same time as usual, but we wait this time to cause damage / move / collide etc.

fields.name: num_vortexes
fields.description: How many vortices do we spawn. These are staggered, launching one per second.

fields.name: composite_scene_blood
fields.description: Blood version

fields.name: affects_allies
fields.description: Does it affect friendly units

fields.name: launch_source_offset
fields.description: used by AI to optimal targeting offset for breaths and winds.

fields.name: composite_scene_group
fields.description: Via group we can configure multiple composite scenes per Vortex Spell

fields.name: is_spell
fields.description: Is the spell damage affected by spell resistance!

fields.name: start_height
fields.description: Determines the starting height for the vortex in the case shape is rectangle. This is in meters.

fields.name: goal_height
fields.description: Determines the ultimate height for the vortex in the case shape is rectangle. The vortex explosion will expand per second according to the ‘expansion_speed’ until goal height is reached.

fields.name: follow_target
fields.description: If 'true' the vortex will follow the target unit with movement_speed but ignoring all other movement properties

fields.name: subsequent_vortex
fields.description: This is the ID of the subsequent vortex to spawn

fields.name: subsequent_vortex_delay
fields.description: This is the delay time of the subsequent vortex to spawn

fields.name: category_icon
fields.description: effect bundle icon for the category display

fields.name: icon
fields.description: icon for tooltips

fields.name: standard_cursor
fields.description: Cursor shown when nothing selected and over this ground type

fields.name: selection_cursor
fields.description: Cursor shown when character selected and over this ground type

fields.name: flag_model_skin_override
fields.description: Use to change model used for campaign flags for this army type (for exmaple used on wh3 caravans). Refers to folder in ui/3dui/models

fields.name: applied_effects
fields.description: What effects to apply to the affected units

fields.name: type
fields.description: Hard-coded ability type. Determines what actually happens to the units.

fields.name: cost_resource_factor
fields.description: Used when paying to apply the ability. Empty means gold.

fields.name: gain_resource_factor
fields.description: Used when gaining a reward for applying the ability. Empty means gold.

fields.name: arrival_window
fields.description: The time (seconds) duration that any of the projectiles can appear

fields.name: num_projectiles
fields.description: The total number of projectiles that will spawn. Their arrival times are random, within the times specified

fields.name: projectile_type
fields.description: This is the projectile that will spawn

fields.name: radius_spread
fields.description: How far away from the target this can theoretically land

fields.name: start_time
fields.description: the minimum time (seconds) that must pass before a projectile can appear

fields.name: launch_source
fields.description: The suggested starting location of the bombardment

fields.name: deterministic_launch_cadence
fields.description: If checked, projectiles will be fired at a regular, deterministic pace over the launch window.

fields.name: lookahead_time
fields.description: Time to look ahead to predict future position of target (intercept vs pursuit).

fields.name: max_target_angle_delta
fields.description: If target angle delta is greater than this threshold, stop homing.

fields.name: start_time
fields.description: Time after launch to start homing.

fields.name: steering_coefficient
fields.description: Multiplier to muzzle speed to get velocity correction per second.

fields.name: description
fields.description: User description.

fields.name: entity_size_cap
fields.description: Size of entity that will stop this projectile immediately.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Unique key.

fields.name: max_penetration
fields.description: Penetration stat. A higher number means this projectile passes through more penetration points before being stopped. Check the battle entities table to see how many penetration points a single entity has.

fields.name: wind_up_aura_vfx
fields.description: This will attempt to override any 'ability aura' metadata in active animations

fields.name: wind_up_weapon_vfx
fields.description: This will attempt to override any 'ability weapon' metadata in active animations

fields.name: sort_order
fields.description: Determines sort order in custom battle screen. Lowest is furthest to left.

fields.name: is_naval
fields.description: Is ability for admirals?

fields.name: button_name
fields.description: This is lookup name for button images which essentially matches agent types,  used for lore selection buttons in battle

fields.name: is_composite_group
fields.description: If yes its a composite lore using abilities/spells from a bunch of other ability groups/lores. These are treated differently on the UI.

fields.name: sound_switch
fields.description: Sound switch to be used by the modular UI system

fields.name: show_lore_icon
fields.description: Should the lore icon appear on the unit card in battle?

fields.name: group_page_order
fields.description: Determines sort order of the group

fields.name: intensity_decay_delay
fields.description: How long in seconds should we wait since the last contribution to the assigned intensity_source before we trigger intensity decay. (-1 means wait infinitely.)

fields.name: intensity_decay_duration
fields.description: A duration in seconds for how long intensity should take to decay from 100% intensity to 0% intensity.

fields.name: reset_intensity_in_reinforcement_pool
fields.description: Reset the intensity of this ability when the unit is recalled to the reinforcement pool in a domination game?

localised_fields.name: alt_description
localised_fields.description: Opposite text, as sometimes this can read better in UI to avoid double negatives

fields.name: attribute_type
fields.description: Positive means the affected will have the attribute, Negative means the affected will negate the attribute

fields.name: active_vfx
fields.description: Active vfx on the target is shown when phase is active

fields.name: banner_vfx
fields.description: Effect that plays around the base of the banner on all units affect by the phase

fields.name: entity_vfx
fields.description: The vfx to display on an entity level

fields.name: use_new_vfx_scaling
fields.description: Enable the new, more aggressive, scaling for this effect.

fields.name: cant_move
fields.description: Makes the unit unable to be given movement or attack orders (entities can still shoot, use abilities or react to melee).

fields.name: freeze_fatigue
fields.description: Makes the unit fatigue state 0 (=fresh) for duration of phase

fields.name: fatigue_change_ratio
fields.description: This is a scalar that changes the unit's fatigue (PER SECOND) relative to the maximum. For example, -0.25 will reduce it by 25% and 0.1 will increase it by 10%

fields.name: ability_recharge_change
fields.description: if the unit has abilities, their recharge will be changed by that amount (negative will reduce the time, positive will increase the time)

fields.name: hp_change_frequency
fields.description: In seconds, how often hp (hit point) change should attempt to be applied

fields.name: damage_amount
fields.description: Per entity, per frequency, what the amount of damage to apply. Note amounts under 4 do not work well on small unit sizes.

fields.name: max_damaged_entities
fields.description: Per damage/heal frequency, how many entities can we affect (negative is no limit)

fields.name: resurrect
fields.description: If ticked, when healing excess hit points will resurrect dead soldiers

fields.name: mana_regen_mod
fields.description: How much we add to the current recharge for mana per second

fields.name: mana_max_depletion_mod
fields.description: How much we add to the current value for max mana depletion

fields.name: imbue_magical
fields.description: Does this phase imbue the target with magical attacks?

fields.name: imbue_ignition
fields.description: Does this phase imbue the target with flaming attacks?

fields.name: imbue_contact
fields.description: Does this phase imbue the target with a contact phase when attacking?

fields.name: phase_display
fields.description: Add groups of visual effects

fields.name: is_hidden_in_ui
fields.description: If true, will not show up in UI

fields.name: replenish_ammo
fields.description: How much ammunition we want to replenish when phase starts (can be negative if we want to spend), this value is in percentage of unit max ammo

fields.name: composite_scene_group
fields.description: Composite scene group we need to trigger when the phase starts

fields.name: freeze_recharge
fields.description: Abilities on the target do not recharge while this phase is active

fields.name: heal_amount
fields.description: When HP (hit points) are healed, how much total should be changed, spread amoungst the entities

fields.name: barrier_heal_amount
fields.description: Each hp_change_frequency ticks, the barrier will heal by this proportion of max_barrier_health

fields.name: execute_ratio
fields.description: At or below this ratio of health the ability will instantly kill its target

fields.name: sort_order
fields.description: Lower is higher in ui

fields.name: effect_state
fields.description: State for effect icon/text colour

fields.name: requires_effect_enabling
fields.description: For the purpose of unlocking the ability via a skill from campaign. If set to false the ability can be enabled/disabled in data for the unit whether it's assigned or not, if set to true the ability will be invisible until it's enabled via data.

fields.name: icon_name
fields.description: This is the icon name in ui/battle ui/ability icons

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type for the ui

fields.name: uniqueness
fields.description: This is 'rarity' of spell, another classification for ui basically

fields.name: is_unit_upgrade
fields.description: If true will appear as toggleable in unit upgrade system in custom battles in frontend. Set to false for effects like crumbling that shouldnt be able to turn off.

fields.name: is_hidden_in_ui
fields.description: If true wont appear anywhere in the UI

fields.name: show_cursor_trail
fields.description: If true, will show a trail following cursor. Requested by joss

fields.name: active_time
fields.description: If this is a projectile then add -1 for active time

fields.name: update_targets_every_frame
fields.description: If active, then each model update it will re-evaluate the targets based on the current position. When off, it will do it once at the start and the targets won't change even if they move in / out of range.

fields.name: always_affect_self
fields.description: The launch unit will always be affected by the ability

fields.name: only_affect_target
fields.description: The ability will only affect the target unit and will not search near units

fields.name: min_range
fields.description: The (targetted) ability can't be used within this range

fields.name: targetting_aoe
fields.description: This is the area of effect to display when targetting

fields.name: passive_aoe
fields.description: This is the area of effect to display when ability has been ordered but not yet cast (like if unit has to move their to cast)

fields.name: active_aoe
fields.description: This is the area of effect to display when ability is currently active (has been cast)

fields.name: activation_effect
fields.description: This is an optional one-shot vfx to display when cast to acknowledge order given

fields.name: miscast_chance
fields.description: The unary chance of a miscast occuring

fields.name: miscast_explosion
fields.description: The boom-boom when miscasting happens

fields.name: special_ability_display
fields.description: When wind_up_stance has an animation added, and windup_time is set to greater than zero, this references a table where you can override effects in the animations metadata.   The effect metadata needs to be set to be set to ability_weapon and ability_aura.

fields.name: voiceover_state
fields.description: the state for the voiceover that's played when this ability is activated (if any)

fields.name: additional_melee_cp
fields.description: Melee Combat Potential that is added to any unit that has this ability/item (from table: main_units). Must be >= 0.0 or the game will crash on startup.

fields.name: additional_missile_cp
fields.description: Missile Combat Potential that is added to any unit that has this ability/item (from table: main_units). Must be >= 0.0 or the game will crash on startup.

fields.name: parent_ability
fields.description: Hack for spell browser in warhammer because designers want to put in specialised versions of abilities for certain characters. An ability with a parent wont show in browser, instead only parent is shown.

fields.name: spawn_proxy_vfx
fields.description: Vfx to show over each proxy decal when targetting spawn spell

fields.name: miscast_global_bonus
fields.description: Setting this to false stops miscast chance modifiers from affecting the ability

fields.name: composite_scene_group_on_wind_up
fields.description: Composite scene group we need to trigger when the ability starts winding up

fields.name: composite_scene_group_on_active
fields.description: Composite scene group we need to trigger when the ability actives

fields.name: use_loop_stance
fields.description: Entities will play a loop locomotion stance

fields.name: spawn_is_transformation
fields.description: If spawning a unit will mean the owner unit will be replaced by the spawned one

fields.name: spawn_is_decoy
fields.description: If spawning a unit the new one will be understood as a decoy of the owner one, the UI will show data for the owning one

fields.name: current_mana_moves_to_reserve
fields.description: If true the current winds of magic mana gets moved to the reserve

fields.name: spawn_shares_health_and_fatigue
fields.description: If spawning a unit will mean the transformed unit health and fatigue will be shared with the owning unit

fields.name: affect_siege_equipment
fields.description: If true affects siege equipment entities

fields.name: shared_recharge_time
fields.description: If provided will set this cooldown timer to all abilities on same group that have the field set

fields.name: intensity_based_activation
fields.description: Activates automatically when intensity is above 0 and deactivates otherwise

fields.name: autoresolver_usage
fields.description: How the ability is used in autoresolver calculations

fields.name: autoresolver_targets
fields.description: Number of targets the ability will hit if it is an aoe ability

fields.name: display_stops_when_display_expires
fields.description: If the ability shoots bombardment/vortex it's display will stop when the assets naturally expire (please make sure the display triggered doesn't loop infinite)

fields.name: autoresolve_cp_multiplier
fields.description: Multiplier for the CP values

fields.name: can_be_copied_to_transformation_unit
fields.description: If this ability can be copied to the connected transformation Unit

fields.name: audio_switch_casting_override
fields.description: If set, ability will use this switch for the modular casting

fields.name: audio_switch_ui_override
fields.description: If set, ability will use this switch for the modular UI

fields.name: ai_usage_template_group
fields.description: If set, ability will trigger on any template.
